introduction: Aravne’s ancient curse leads from nine different hearts to a throne-room key, then to a separate royal return. Babedo offers a legacy luck-scroll exchange. Sand for Dawndale, guarded information and epic training add other leads. Discovery is separate; new progress requires active, ready accounting.
orientation: ASK ANESENTHE about weep, proof, hi or quest. Her actual name is Anesenthe. She asks for nine different hearts: Enzekail, both alpha weretors, Auruos, Solos, Berbrathus, Grgak, Akethis and Akiniere. Carry one of each loose; nine copies of one HEART cannot replace nine different kinds.

The first accepted return awards an ornate gold key and experience. The next native recipe accepts the hearts of Cacazar, Elan’Atol and the King for a blade, gauntlets and experience. The suggested route uses the key at the throne room, but the final recipe has no required earlier journal receipt. Matching supplied hearts fit; personal combat, first recovery, door access and lifting the curse are different facts.

Other access leads include the stargazer lord’s star-marked key, Kotuss’s mansion key, the sun guardian’s key and a sigil-marked key on a kings gate guard. Keys, an already-open shared door and actual successful entry are separate from accepted proof. The reverse stargazer exit declares a different key value; do not assume every direction has the same requirement.

Babedo’s ambient speech describes a legacy exchange: Bel’s heart, the Dark’s orb and a stone tablet return a luck scroll. The tablet has no declared reset source in the reviewed world, and the scroll has no bound stat-use effect. Babedo is also bound as an epic luck trainer during full boot; that practice purchase is separate and is refused while accounting is active.

ASK MAROONED about unique, major, ioun or artifacts for the xixchil’s information-service explanation. The native LIST unique/main-or-major/ioun options quote 50/500/175 platinum. Purchases are refused while accounting is active. Questions give leads without charging or creating a keyword achievement; this service is not a local accepted quest return.

The sand elemental near the city ghetto creates a pile of fine sand through a death handler. The high-elven smith in Dawndale requests that exact sand and 25 platinum for a lens. This is an outside-zone handoff, not a fourth Aravne return. Custom sand creation needs accounting admission; seeing sand, receiving it from another player and first source recovery are separate.

GRAB the declared vine, or ENTER the pool, lifting portal, chute or underbrush where present, for exploration leads. Prime Tree visions, Tor awakening, an innocence leaf, noble-home columns, dead animals, crafting descriptions and merchant roles do not alone establish an accepted quest or permanent world change. Optional material rows show loose supplies now; accepted history remains after spending them. Stock and possible dailies require separate accounting qualification.

contacts.name: Anesenthe
contacts.description: The greater dryad explains the curse and accepts two independent exact-heart offerings. The first returns a throne-room key; the second returns the royal equipment. Acceptance does not itself record a lifted curse.

contacts.name: Babedo
contacts.description: The halfling hero has a legacy three-item luck-scroll return and ambient requests. A full-boot dynamic binding also makes him an epic luck trainer; that guarded practice service is separate from the old scroll.

contacts.name: a marooned xixchil
contacts.description: The marooned xixchil explains artifact-location categories. His paid LIST service is unavailable while accounting is active; no synthetic payment receipt or keyword achievement is added.

contacts.name: a sand elemental
contacts.description: The sand elemental’s enabled death handler creates fine sand for a Dawndale smith. Accounting issuance and first-source provenance need qualification; a matching player-supplied item is not proof of a personal kill.

contacts.name: a stargazer lord
contacts.description: Carries a star-marked key for the guarded route toward Auruos. Possession is a source lead, not a recorded successful unlock or an accepted local quest.

contacts.name: Kotuss
contacts.description: Carries the mansion key on the route toward Berbrathus. His request to be freed is narrative context without a selected peaceful key-award exchange.

contacts.name: a sun guardian
contacts.description: Carries a key for the route toward Solos. Shared door state, key recovery and personal combat remain separate.

contacts.name: a kings gate guard
contacts.description: A kings gate guard declares a sigil-marked key for the royal courtyard. Multiple guards share this target name, so identify the intended carrier rather than treating every guard as a quest giver.

stories.title: Nine hearts for the throne-room key
stories.summary: Bring nine different hearts to Anesenthe for an ornate gold key and experience. The longer curse story explains the journey; accepted proof does not separately verify personal kills, first recovery or a restored city.
